title: SPSA Hyperparameter Tuning for Variational Quantum Natural Language Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.16939v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training variational quantum models requires choosing between parameter-shift gradients, which are exact but cost $O(P)$ forward evaluations, and simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation (SPSA), which uses only two samples but produces high-variance estimates that can degrade optimisation on small supervised tasks. Whether the cheap gradient is usable depends on the variance that results from different choices of the SPSA perturbation scale, learning rate, and gain-decay schedule. translated_title: 基于SPSA超参数调优的变分量子自然语言推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16939v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：训练变分量子模型需要在参数位移梯度（精确但每次前向评估成本为$O(P)$）和同时扰动随机逼近（SPSA）（仅使用两个样本但产生高方差估计，可能在小规模监督任务上劣化优化效果）之间进行选择。廉价梯度是否可用取决于不同SPSA扰动尺度、学习率和增益衰减调度选择导致的方差。我们在一个6量子比特、60参数的QNLI分类器上，在广泛的网格中变化这些量，并将最佳配置与参数位移AdamW和BuresQNG进行比较。AdamW风格的SPSA，设置$c_0=0.01$，$\eta=0.10$，$\gamma=0.10$，达到$55\% \pm 11\%$的测试准确率，优于默认配置（$49\% \pm 6\%$），但仍比参数位移基线低16-19个百分点，因为两样本SPSA梯度估计方差过大。
tldr: 本文通过系统调优SPSA超参数（扰动尺度、学习率和增益衰减）在6量子比特QNLI任务上，发现AdamW风格SPSA虽能提升准确率但无法超越参数位移基线，表明其高方差梯度估计限制了在变分量子自然语言推理中的适用性。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically tunes SPSA hyperparameters (perturbation scale, learning rate, gain decay) on a 6-qubit QNLI task, finding that AdamW-style SPSA improves accuracy but cannot surpass parameter-shift baselines, due to high-variance gradient estimates limiting its applicability in variational quantum natural language inference.
